title: 30th Anniversary Matsuri

venue.name: W5 LIFE at the O2 Belfast

description: A vibrant, family-friendly Japanese festival marking JSNI's 30th Anniversary, with performances, workshops, demonstrations and hands-on activities for all ages. Supported by; W5 LIFE, The Japan Society UK, Rakuten, Ryobi, Camseng, Japan Foundation and Fujitsu.
details: Delivered by JSNI volunteers along with societies and clubs engaged in Japanese art, culture and sport. Highlights include Ibuki Taiko drumming, Japanese dance, folklore storytelling by Masako Carey, martial arts demonstrations (Belfast MET Judo, Abbey Judo, Ojika Kendo, Iaido, Sumo na hEireann), calligraphy and origami workshops, an ikebana and bonsai exhibition (NIBS), children's festival games including yo-yo fishing and goldfish scooping, and a big Obon circle dance to close the day. Entry is free, though some activities and the market require cash. Children should be accompanied by a responsible adult. JSNI membership registration for the 2026-27 season will be available on the day.

title: Mela Carnival 2026
details: JSNI is once again joining Mela Carnival, organised by ArtsEkta. Expect giant carnival creations, spectacular costumes, pulsating world music, dance, live performance and hundreds of community participants transforming Belfast into a vibrant celebration of culture and creativity. The celebrations don't stop there - enjoy a free afternoon of music, workshops, performances and family fun across Belfast Cathedral Quarter. Free to attend. Everyone's welcome.

title: Mela Day 2026
details: JSNI is once again joining Mela Day, organised by ArtsEkta. We will be at the Little Asia zone at the back of Rose Garden along with Ojika Dojo Kendo and NI Bonsai Society. Come along and dance with us, try ikebana, dress up in Japanese costume and children can have a go at our popular yo-yo fishing game!

title: Autumn Fair
description: Food, flower exhibitions, family fun and music.
details: JSNI will be with Northern Ireland Bonsai Society (NIBS) at the Belfast Autumn Fair to celebrate their 40th Anniversary. Come along to see their beautiful bonsai trees and have a go at  Origami with our JSNI volunteers. Organised by Belfast City Council and NIBS.
